trigger: Full-pool single-asset sweep undertaken ahead of building the real HistoricalEvent registry and running the actual select_frozen_cohort(seed=100100) freeze. Discovered that only 11 of the 152 universe-PASS candidates had both financing and single-asset status fully resolved - all prior single-asset work targeted specific seed-selected or negative-event candidates, never swept the full pool. Since HistoricalEvent.single_asset_issuer is a required boolean with no PENDING state, every candidate considered for registry inclusion needs a genuine, evidenced determination. This batch resolves all 106 remaining universe-PASS candidates.
qualification_rule: Count only a company whose pre-event filings (most recent 10-K/10-K405/20-F filed before the event; 10-K/A Part-III-only compensation amendments are excluded in favor of the underlying annual report) show one meaningful active clinical-stage or marketed therapeutic asset, where any other named compound is explicitly framed as a preclinical/backup/discontinued program rather than a separate active development effort. For each determination, the pre-event business-overview text was read directly, and for most candidates a broad compound-code scan (regex over drug-code patterns appearing 3+ times in the business section) was additionally run to catch a second active compound that might not appear in the immediate overview paragraph - this caught at least one case (Ardelyx/RDX013) that would otherwise have been missed.

promotion_boundary: Single-asset status alone does not establish final M7 eligibility. This batch, combined with single-asset-evidence-ledger-09/-10/-11.json, completes single-asset determination for the entire universe-PASS pool (152 of 152 candidates now resolved, zero PENDING). Financing determination was separately completed in financing-evidence-ledger-06/-07/-08.json. Per newly-sourced-batch-13.json's RNG order-sensitivity finding, no simulated selected-cohort subset count from this data should be treated as a stable pre-registry prediction; pool-wide aggregate sufficiency is the only reliable readiness signal until the real HistoricalEvent registry exists.
